User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the groupchat application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user. This is the Firebase UID.

profilePictureUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

fcmTokens.description: Array of Firebase Cloud Messaging tokens for push notifications.

adminId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Group). The user ID of the group administrator.

memberIds.description: References to Users. (Relationship: Group 1:N User) Array of user IDs that are members of this group.

photoURL.description: URL of the group's avatar picture.

lastMessage.description: A summary of the last message sent in the group for display in the group list.

lastRead.description: Map of user IDs to the timestamp of their last read message in this group.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a message within a group chat.

groupId.description: Reference to Group. (Relationship: Group 1:N Message). The ID of the group this message belongs to.

senderId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Message). The ID of the user who sent the message.

content.description: The content of the message (text or URL for files/images).

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the message was sent.

contentType.description: The content Type of the message. Values can be 'text', 'image', 'file'.

reactions.description: A map of emoji reactions to a list of user IDs who reacted.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. Uses path-based ownership, so only the user can read/write their own profile.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase UID of the user.

definition.description: Stores group information, including name, adminId, and memberIds.
Stores messages within a group. Includes denormalized 'groupId', 'senderId', 'memberIds' (copied from the parent Group document) for authorization independence.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the group the message belongs to.

definition.description: Document existence indicates admin role for the user.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support a real-time group chat application (groupchat) with a focus on secure access control and efficient data retrieval. It leverages path-based ownership for user data and a membership map for group authorization. To ensure Authorization Independence, key authorization data (adminId and memberIds) from the `Group` document is denormalized to the `Message` documents. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules when writing messages. This strategy ensures atomic operations and simplifies security rule logic. Furthermore, separate collections for user profiles, groups, and messages ensure a clear separation of concerns and enable secure `list` operations.

The structure also takes into consideration the app requirements of push notifications and scalable data models. Segregation by path enables scalable queries and optimized read operations.
